properties.name: East Sulawesi Ophiolite Belt
properties.description: Nickel laterite district hosting Sorowako, Morowali, Pomalaa, Konawe, Tapunopaka
properties.source: Sukamto, R. (1975) Geological Map of Indonesia, Ujung Pandang Sheet. GRDC Bandung.

properties.name: Halmahera Ophiolite Belt
properties.description: Central Halmahera laterite district hosting Weda Bay nickel mine
properties.source: Hall, R. & Wilson, M.E.J. (2000) Neogene sutures in eastern Indonesia. J. Asian Earth Sci. 18(6), 781–808.

properties.name: Obi Island Ophiolite
properties.description: Obi Island nickel laterite district, Harita Group mining area
properties.source: Mindat.org Obi Island locality 453808; Earthworks (2025) Obi Island report.

properties.name: Waigeo-Gag Ophiolite Belt
properties.description: Gag Island and Waigeo laterite district, Antam Gag Nikel operation
properties.source: GRDC Papua geological map sheet; Antam annual report.

properties.name: Southeast Sulawesi Nickel District
properties.description: Bombana and Kabaena laterite occurrences, smaller scale deposits
properties.source: Simandjuntak et al. (1994) Geological Map of Kolaka Sheet, GRDC.
